/* PERSON DIMENSION */
TRUNCATE TABLE gold.DimPerson;

INSERT INTO gold.DimPerson
(
    PersonID,
    BankAccountNumber,
    BankID,
    PersonAge,
    PersonEducation,
    PersonGender,
    PersonMaritalStatus,
    PersonOccupation,
    GoldLoadedAt
)
SELECT
    PersonID,
    BankAccountNumber,
    BankID,
    PersonAge,
    PersonEducation,
    PersonGender,
    PersonMaritalStatus,
    PersonOccupation,
    SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM [LH_PULSE_SILVER].[silver].[person];


/* MERCHANT DIMENSION */
TRUNCATE TABLE gold.DimMerchant;

INSERT INTO gold.DimMerchant
(
    MerchantRecordID,
    MerchantID,
    BankAccountNumber,
    BankID,
    Description,
    MerchantType,
    RegisteredCapital,
    Industry,
    OperatingStatus,
    EstablishmentDate,
    LegalRepresentativeID,
    GoldLoadedAt
)
SELECT
    MerchantRecordID,
    MerchantID,
    BankAccountNumber,
    BankID,
    Description,
    MerchantType,
    RegisteredCapital,
    Industry,
    OperatingStatus,
    EstablishmentDate,
    LegalRepresentativeID,
    SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM [LH_PULSE_SILVER].[silver].[merchant];


/* HISTORICAL TRANSACTION FACT */
INSERT INTO gold.FactTransaction
(
    TransactionID,
    TransactionTimestamp,
    TransactionDate,
    FromBankID,
    FromAccount,
    ToBankID,
    ToAccount,
    AmountReceived,
    ReceivingCurrency,
    AmountPaid,
    PaymentCurrency,
    PaymentFormat,
    IsLaundering,
    GoldLoadedAt
)
SELECT
    s.TransactionID,
    s.TransactionTimestamp,
    s.TransactionDate,
    s.FromBankID,
    s.FromAccount,
    s.ToBankID,
    s.ToAccount,
    s.AmountReceived,
    s.ReceivingCurrency,
    s.AmountPaid,
    s.PaymentCurrency,
    s.PaymentFormat,
    s.IsLaundering,
    SYSUTCDATETIME()
FROM [LH_PULSE_SILVER].[silver].[transaction_detail] s
WHERE NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.FactTransaction g
    WHERE g.TransactionID = s.TransactionID
);

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold.DimPerson) AS PersonCount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold.DimMerchant) AS MerchantCount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold.FactTransaction) AS TransactionCount,
    (
        SELECT MAX(TransactionID)
        FROM [LH_PULSE_SILVER].[silver].[transaction_detail]
    ) AS EndWatermark;

@concat(
'UPDATE ctl.SilverWatermark
 SET LastSuccessfulWatermark = ''',
string(activity('LKP_GOLD_COUNTS').output.firstRow.EndWatermark),
''',
 LastSuccessfulRunId = ''',
pipeline().RunId,
''',
 UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME()
 WHERE EntityName = ''TransactionDetail'';'
)
